summary: Ferrari N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release that announces the release date of its first quarter 2026 financial results on May 5, 2026, and provides details for a live audio webcast and conference call. This is a routine quarterly earnings announcement, not a special situation transaction. No terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics are involved. As a standard disclosure for foreign private issuers, the filing requires no special-situations classification; it merely relays an upcoming earnings event with no actionable corporate action for investors.
